system.description: When you would make an attack targeting a creature their attempts to protect themselves were already a part of your calculations as you spend 1 Superiority Die. When you do, if the target would gain a bonus to their AC as part of a reaction they took, they must make a Chakra control check vs your attacks save DC (If Weapon/Unarmed, Taijutsu save DC). On a failure, they lose the bonus to their AC until the end of the current turn.
